title: MLX Benchmark Result
description: Structured result envelope for a single benchmark suite run. Backwards-compatible v1 — optional fields may be added without bumping schema_version; breaking changes bump the version and change $id.
$comment: v1 additive fields (no version bump): top-level env_class, concurrency, reasoning_effort, serving; system.topology for multi-node cluster runs. 2026-07-27: results[].total_tokens_per_second is now the headline throughput metric (cumulative prompt+completion tok/s) — decode_tokens_per_second and prompt_tokens_per_second remain as supporting detail; no field added or removed, descriptions updated only. 2026-10-04: NVIDIA/CUDA hosts — system.gpu, system.engine, system.power_limit_w, system.container are optional additions; suite enum gains gpu-burn, nvbandwidth, mbw, fio; results[].tags documents the prompt_tokens / concurrency / context_len keys. All additive, legacy envelopes validate unchanged. 2026-10-05: optional campaign_dimensions and dimension_null_reasons record hardware, software, model, run, speed, resource, quality, provenance, and cost dimensions. The publisher flattens these into a fixed nullable Parquet schema. 2026-10-07: optional model_task and model_task_source capture the Hugging Face model-card pipeline tag or identify an inferred official task tag. Top-level git_sha remains required but accepts null when the runtime code revision was not captured.

schema_version.description: Schema version — bump when making breaking changes

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the run started

git_sha.description: Full or short git commit SHA of the repo at run time

pr_number.description: Pull request number if trigger is 'pr', otherwise null

model.description: Model name/ID used for inference (e.g. Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-4bit)

model_task.description: Hugging Face pipeline_tag from the model card, or the closest official Hugging Face task name when the card has no tag.

model_task_source.description: Use model_card when model_task is the published pipeline_tag; use inferred when the card has no tag.

model_revision.description: HuggingFace revision (tag or commit SHA) pinned at inference time

quantization.description: Quantization scheme as reported by the runtime (e.g. mlx-4bit, mxfp4, mxfp8)

campaign.description: Optional immutable campaign and cell identity for a coordinated local benchmark run.

campaign_dimensions.description: Optional first-class performance campaign dimensions. Each category is optional so legacy envelopes remain valid; unknown values may be explicit nulls.

hardware.description: Optional hardware dimensions for detailed benchmark campaigns. Explicit null values are retained in the stable Parquet columns.

machine.description: Machine product/model label; omit the private hostname.

accelerator_model.description: Accelerator model or integrated GPU model.

accelerator_memory_gb.description: Accelerator or unified memory capacity in GB.

memory_bandwidth_gbps.description: Memory bandwidth in GB/s; identify a vendor-rated value in result tags.

host_cpu.description: Host CPU model and core layout.

host_ram_gb.description: Host physical RAM capacity in GB.

host_ram_speed_mts.description: Host memory transfer rate in MT/s, when reported separately.

pcie_generation.description: Active PCIe generation for a discrete accelerator.

pcie_width_lanes.description: Active PCIe link width in lanes.

power_cap_w.description: Configured accelerator power cap in watts.

ups_circuit.description: UPS and circuit assignment, when available.

software.description: Optional software dimensions for detailed benchmark campaigns. Explicit null values are retained in the stable Parquet columns.

accelerator_runtime.description: CUDA, Metal, or ROCm runtime version.

engine_commit.description: Inference engine source commit SHA, when available.

backend.description: Execution backend such as CUDA, Metal, Vulkan, or ROCm.

gpu_architectures.description: GPU architecture targets included in the build.

build_flags.description: Additional engine build flags recorded as JSON-compatible scalar values.

flash_attention.description: Whether flash attention was enabled in the build or run.

model.description: Optional model dimensions for detailed benchmark campaigns. Explicit null values are retained in the stable Parquet columns.

revision_sha.description: Immutable Hugging Face model revision SHA.

experts_total.description: Total expert count for MoE models.

experts_active.description: Active expert count per token for MoE models.

bits_per_weight.description: Effective bits per weight when reported.

file_size_gb.description: Model weight file size in GB.

license.description: License reported by the pinned model source.

file_sha256.description: SHA-256 of a single model weight file, when recorded.

run.description: Optional run dimensions for detailed benchmark campaigns. Explicit null values are retained in the stable Parquet columns.

prompt_tokens.description: Prompt token count for each request.

concurrent_agents.description: Number of concurrent requests or agents.

speculative_mtp.description: Whether speculative or multi-token prediction was enabled.

draft_model.description: Draft model used for speculative decoding.

thinking.description: Whether reasoning or thinking mode was enabled.

chat_template.description: Chat-template identity, revision, or content hash.

warm_cold.description: Whether weights and runtime were warm or cold.

speed.description: Optional speed dimensions for detailed benchmark campaigns. Explicit null values are retained in the stable Parquet columns.

ttft_p50_ms.description: Median time to first token in milliseconds.

ttft_p90_ms.description: 90th percentile time to first token in milliseconds.

ttft_p99_ms.description: 99th percentile time to first token in milliseconds.

prefill_tokens_per_second.description: Prompt prefill throughput in tokens per second.

decode_tokens_per_second_per_agent.description: Per-request decode throughput in tokens per second.

aggregate_output_tokens_per_second.description: Aggregate output throughput across concurrent requests.

total_tokens_per_second.description: Prompt plus output tokens divided by wall time.

tpot_ms.description: Average time per output token in milliseconds.

mtp_acceptance_rate.description: Accepted speculative or MTP tokens divided by proposed tokens.

request_success_rate.description: Successful requests divided by all attempted requests.

resource.description: Optional resource dimensions for detailed benchmark campaigns. Explicit null values are retained in the stable Parquet columns.

accelerator_memory_peak_gb.description: Peak VRAM or unified memory used in GB.

host_ram_peak_gb.description: Peak host RAM used in GB.

cpu_offload_layers.description: Model layers placed on CPU instead of the accelerator.

gpu_utilization_avg_percent.description: Average GPU utilization percentage over the recorded run window.

gpu_utilization_max_percent.description: Maximum GPU utilization percentage over the recorded run window.

cpu_performance_utilization_avg_percent.description: Average utilization of performance CPU cores over the recorded run window.

cpu_efficiency_utilization_avg_percent.description: Average utilization of efficiency CPU cores over the recorded run window.

power_avg_w.description: Average primary accelerator or system power in watts; describe the measurement scope in result tags.

power_max_w.description: Maximum primary accelerator or system power in watts; describe the measurement scope in result tags.

soc_power_avg_w.description: Average combined SoC power in watts, when the runtime reports it.

soc_power_max_w.description: Maximum combined SoC power in watts, when the runtime reports it.

cpu_power_avg_w.description: Average CPU power in watts, when the runtime reports it.

cpu_power_max_w.description: Maximum CPU power in watts, when the runtime reports it.

memory_power_avg_w.description: Average main-memory power in watts, when the runtime reports it.

memory_power_max_w.description: Maximum main-memory power in watts, when the runtime reports it.

accelerator_memory_power_avg_w.description: Average accelerator-memory power in watts, when the runtime reports it.

accelerator_memory_power_max_w.description: Maximum accelerator-memory power in watts, when the runtime reports it.

ane_power_avg_w.description: Average neural-engine power in watts, when the runtime reports it.

ane_power_max_w.description: Maximum neural-engine power in watts, when the runtime reports it.

energy_j_per_output_token.description: Energy in joules divided by measured output tokens.

tokens_per_second_per_watt.description: Output tokens per second divided by watts.

temperature_max_c.description: Maximum accelerator or SoC temperature in Celsius.

average_clocks_mhz.description: Average accelerator clock frequency in MHz.

cpu_performance_clock_avg_mhz.description: Average performance-core CPU frequency in MHz, when reported.

cpu_efficiency_clock_avg_mhz.description: Average efficiency-core CPU frequency in MHz, when reported.

throttle_reasons.description: Thermal, power, or reliability throttle reasons observed.

fan_percent.description: Fan speed as a percentage of maximum.

quality.description: Optional quality dimensions for detailed benchmark campaigns. Explicit null values are retained in the stable Parquet columns.

provenance.description: Optional provenance dimensions for detailed benchmark campaigns. Explicit null values are retained in the stable Parquet columns.

timestamp_utc.description: UTC timestamp for the measured run.

config_git_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the benchmark configuration.

raw_output_path.description: Path to the matching raw benchmark output.

schema_version.description: Envelope schema version used for this result.

cost.description: Optional cost dimensions for detailed benchmark campaigns. Explicit null values are retained in the stable Parquet columns.

kwh_per_million_output_tokens.description: Energy in kWh per million output tokens.

local_electricity_usd_per_million_tokens.description: Local electricity cost in USD per million output tokens.

median_rental_usd_per_million_tokens.description: Median rental cost in USD per million output tokens.

median_api_usd_per_million_tokens.description: Median API cost in USD per million output tokens.

dimension_null_reasons.description: Optional field-path to reason-code map for explicit nulls in campaign_dimensions.

cell_status.description: Protocol status for this cell. Only success rows carry scored benchmark metrics.

context.description: Context dimensions kept separate so configured capacity is never confused with actual prompt length.

skipped.description: True when the suite was skipped (e.g. MLX server unavailable on standard runner)

seed.description: RNG seed used for generation (when applicable)

gen_kwargs.description: Generation hyperparameters as passed to the inference API

env_class.description: Machine load class during the run: 'isolated' (nothing else contending for the box) or 'under-load' (other significant workloads present). Verdict policy gate 3 requires distinguishing these.

concurrency.description: Number of in-flight requests the run drove concurrently. 1 for serial runs; higher values contend and depress per-request throughput.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning/thinking effort the run asked the model for, verbatim as sent (e.g. 'low', 'high', 'xhigh', 'max', 'off'). Declared by the caller — a harness cannot observe a serving default or an agent CLI's own config. 'unstated' when no level was declared: absent is NOT the same as off, and a plausible guess here is indistinguishable from a measurement. Deliberately not an enum, because each model family names its own levels and rewriting one into another merges arms that are not the same arm.

serving.description: Identity of the inference server the run targeted

endpoint_port.description: TCP port the OpenAI-compatible endpoint listened on

served_model.description: Model id as advertised by the endpoint (may differ from 'model')

hostname.description: Short host label of the machine that ran the benchmark — distinguishes machines with identical chip/memory (e.g. a Mac Studio vs a MacBook Pro)

runner.description: GitHub Actions runner label (e.g. macos-latest, self-hosted)

gpu.description: Discrete NVIDIA GPU the run executed on, as reported by nvidia-smi. Absent for Apple Silicon and CPU-only runs.

model.description: GPU product name as reported by the driver (nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name)

vram_gb.description: Total GPU memory in GiB (nvidia-smi memory.total / 1024) — the same binary unit memory_gb uses, so it can be fractional

cuda.description: Highest CUDA version the driver supports, from the nvidia-smi header (e.g. 12.8)

engine.description: Inference engine that served the model (e.g. vllm, sglang, llama.cpp). Complements serving.stack, which names the server endpoint; engine carries the version a throughput number depends on.

power_limit_w.description: Enforced GPU board power limit in watts (nvidia-smi --query-gpu=power.limit). Throughput and sustained-compute results move with it, so two limits are two arms.

container.description: Container image reference the engine ran in (e.g. 'vllm/vllm-openai:v0.30.0'), when the run was containerized. Absent for bare-metal runs.

topology.description: Multi-node cluster topology when the run spanned more than one machine (e.g. a two-Mac TB5 pipeline). Absent for single-node runs.

world_size.description: Total number of nodes participating in the run

parallelism.description: How the model was split across nodes

duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock duration attributed to this result (first-class, replacing tags.total_eval_time_s for new runs)

prompt_tokens_per_second.description: Aggregate prompt (prefill) throughput for this result: sum of prompt tokens across all samples divided by duration_seconds. Optional — populated when sample-level token counts are recoverable (e.g. lm-eval --log_samples + tokenizer).

decode_tokens_per_second.description: Aggregate decode (completion) throughput: sum of response tokens divided by duration_seconds. Supporting detail, not the headline number — a decode-only rate hides prefill-engine improvements entirely, even though a faster prefill is a real, felt latency win for any non-trivial prompt. See total_tokens_per_second for the headline metric.

total_tokens_per_second.description: PRIMARY / headline throughput metric: aggregate end-to-end (cumulative) throughput, (prompt + response) tokens divided by duration_seconds. Counts prefill and decode toward the same number because both are real time a caller waits on — a model with a much faster prefill and identical decode speed is genuinely faster in practice, and this is the field that reflects it. Prefer this over decode_tokens_per_second when reporting or comparing models.

first_token_latency_ms.description: Time to first token in milliseconds for this result (when measurable — typically populated by streaming-aware harnesses, left unset for lm-eval runs).

peak_rss_mb.description: Peak resident set size observed during this result, in megabytes. Complements memory_snapshots when per-result granularity is available.

tags.description: Arbitrary string key-value metadata (e.g. framework, output_tokens). Every value is a string, numbers included. Conventional sweep-dimension keys: prompt_tokens, concurrency, context_len.

prompt_tokens.description: Prompt length of each request in this cell, in tokens, as requested (e.g. '8192'). Not the server's configured window.

concurrency.description: In-flight request count this cell drove (e.g. '4'). Same meaning as the top-level concurrency field, repeated here so one parquet row is self-describing.

context_len.description: Context window the server was configured with, in tokens (e.g. vLLM --max-model-len). Capacity, never the actual prompt length — see prompt_tokens and the top-level context object.

raw.description: Original unmodified output from the underlying tool or script

memory_snapshots.description: Memory usage measurements at different phases of the run

errors.description: Non-fatal errors or warnings encountered during the run
